q027.question: What is the average time between orders for a customer?
q027.actual_sql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         o.order_purchase_timestamp,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT cur.customer_unique_id,
         (julianday(cur.order_purchase_timestamp) - julianday(prev.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS interorder_days
  FROM ordered cur
  JOIN ordered prev
    ON cur.customer_unique_id = prev.customer_unique_id
   AND cur.rn = prev.rn + 1
),
per_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id,
         AVG(interorder_days) AS avg_interorder
  FROM diffs
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_interorder) AS average_time_between_orders
FROM per_customer

  SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)

q066.question: How does distance affect delivery time? (approx via location)
q066.actual_sql:
WITH geo AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    AVG(geolocation_lat) AS lat,
    AVG(geolocation_lng) AS lng
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    (julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) * 24 AS delivery_hours,
    g.lat,
    g.lng
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN geo g ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SQRT(lat*lat + lng*lng) < 10 THEN '0-10'
    WHEN SQRT(lat*lat + lng*lng) < 20 THEN '10-20'
    WHEN SQRT(lat*lat + lng*lng) < 30 THEN '20-30'
    ELSE '30+'
  END AS distance_bucket,
  AVG(delivery_hours) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM joined
GROUP BY distance_bucket
ORDER BY distance_bucket

  JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id

  FROM orders o

  SELECT order_id, payment_type
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id, payment_type
)
SELECT
  p.payment_type,
  SUM(i.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN payments_agg p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
